name: Park Tower Hall
address: Shinjuku Park Tower, 3-7-1 Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo 163-1004
accessSummary: Hatsudai Station (Keio New Line): about 6 min walk / Tochomae Station (Toei Oedo Line) Exit A4: about 8 min walk / Shinjuku Station (Toei Shinjuku Line, Keio New Line): about 10 min walk / Sangubashi Station (Odakyu Line): about 10 min walk / Shinjuku Station South Exit (JR lines): about 12 min walk
hours: Hours of use include setup and clean-up. Hall: full-day use 9:00-21:00, extension outside hours 7:00-9:00 / 21:00-23:00. 1F Gallery and Atrium: full-day use 9:00-19:00, extension outside hours 7:00-9:00 / 19:00-23:00. The management office reception is open weekdays 10:00-18:00 (excluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays). The full-day use hours differ by page: the rental space list gives 9:00-19:00 for the Hall, while the Hall's own page and the guide to use PDF give 9:00-21:00 (the latter, which agree, are adopted).
notice: The 3F Hall is scheduled to be temporarily closed from Thursday, April 1, 2027 to Saturday, September 30, 2028 for building renovation work on Shinjuku Park Tower (the 1F rental spaces operate as usual). Reservations for the 3F Hall from October 2028 onward are scheduled to reopen in October 2027. The 2F Open Deck Gallery is an interior renovation area and cannot be used for the time being.

rooms.name: Hall (3F)
rooms.note: About 450㎡. Flat-floor type with no pillars. Classroom is 3 per desk. Full-day use 900,000 yen (excl. tax).

rooms.name: Foyer (3F)
rooms.note: About 190㎡. Use of the Hall is a condition, and it is included in the Hall fee.

rooms.name: GALLERY 1 (1F)
rooms.note: About 215㎡. Classroom is 3 per desk. Full-day use 180,000 yen (excl. tax). Event power supply 100V 15A x 7 circuits.

rooms.name: GALLERY 3 (1F)
rooms.note: About 215㎡. Full-day use 80,000 yen (excl. tax). Event power supply 100V 15A x 5 circuits.

rooms.name: Atrium (1F)
rooms.note: About 400㎡. Full-day use 150,000 yen (excl. tax). Event power supply 100V 15A x 7 circuits, temporary power panel 20kVA.

rooms.name: Open Deck Gallery (2F)
rooms.note: About 180㎡. Use of the Atrium is a condition; full-day use 20,000 yen (excl. tax). Currently unavailable because it is an interior renovation area.

ops.prevDaySetup: If the space is used for the full day (9:00-21:00) only for preparation, setup, rehearsal and dismantling, it can be used for 450,000 yen (excl. tax) for one day only per event, on condition that there is a full-day use on the day of the event. The hours of use include all time for preparation, setup, rehearsal, dismantling and so on, and the hours of use are fixed at the time of contract.
ops.loadingHours: For loading and construction in the 1F Gallery and Atrium, work cannot be done 12:00-13:00 and the loading doors are locked. Vehicle entry and exit and loading work cannot be done 8:00-9:00, 12:00-13:00 and 17:00-18:00 (Construction Rules dated April 1, 2026). Workers wear armbands handed out at the Shinjuku Park Tower Disaster Prevention Center. The 3F Hall connects directly from its dedicated parking space by a dedicated large elevator, so equipment can be loaded in and out. Details of loading, setup and dismantling are fixed by 1 month before use.
ops.vehicleRules: Loading and unloading vehicles must park in the designated places and along the designated routes, and loading of long, large items requires coordination. Unauthorized parking on the building grounds and street or illegal parking on the surrounding roads is refused. The 3F Hall has a dedicated parking space for 2 vehicles. Heavy or long items have limits on weight, size and installation method, so consult the Hall staff in advance.
ops.parking: Shinjuku Park Tower underground parking: 7:00-23:30, 330 yen per 30 minutes, maximum charge 2,100 yen. Vehicle limits: height 2.1m, length 5.6m, width 2.1m, weight 3.0t. Open all year except the days when the whole of Shinjuku Park Tower is closed.
ops.waitingRooms: Waiting Rooms A, B and C (3F) are 3 rooms of about 50㎡ each, and the 3 rooms can be used as one. There is 1 organizer waiting room (3F) of about 25㎡. All are included in the Hall usage fee.
ops.catering: Catering companies introduced are CBS Catering, Izumi Restaurant, Latia Creates, Dynac and Circus. Behind the bar counter in the Foyer there is a pantry with a large refrigerator and ice machine, which supports catering. Food and drink must be consumed in the designated places, and if the floor is soiled, a cleaning fee (5,000 yen per tile carpet) is charged (estimate example for April 1 to September 30, 2026).
